jobs.title: Trust & Safety Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own the operating floor of Trust & Safety at Suno: review queues, vendor capacity, quality programs, SLAs, and escalation workflows. Our enforcement system blends automated decisioning with human judgment, and your job is to make the human side of that system fast, accurate, and worth every dollar it costs. You will report to our Trust & Safety lead and work closely with Product, Eng, Legal, Comms, and the broader Operations team.

Listen to the song we made about the role: https://suno.com/s/bWZ30M98bvirsCPq




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Run day-to-day enforcement operations: queue health, latency, SLA attainment and escalation handling across all content categories.

 - Own vendor and BPO performance: capacity forecasting, quality enforcement, contract performance and site management.

 - Build and run the training, QA, and calibration program that keeps decision quality measurable and improving.

 - Manage capacity planning against rapid volume growth, including the tradeoffs between headcount, vendor spend, and automation.

 - Define tooling requirements for reviewer workflows and partner with Engineering to ship them.

 - Support reviewer wellness and resilience programs for the teams doing the hardest work on the platform.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years in Trust & Safety, content moderation, or CX operations, including 2+ years directly managing reviewers or vendor teams.

 - Ownership of operational metrics you can speak to concretely: SLA attainment, queue latency, QA scores, cost per decision, reviewer utilization.

 - Hands-on vendor or BPO management with real performance accountability, not just relationship handling.

 - Experience building or running a QA and calibration program with measurable decision-quality outcomes.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Operating experience alongside ML-assisted enforcement: queue routing on model scores, human-in-the-loop workflows.

 - Reviewer wellness and resilience program exposure.

 - UGC or generative AI platform background.


PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

$128K -$168K





Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. This is a role for someone who wants full ownership of a client group and the trust to run it well: using data, judgment, and influence to help leaders build high-performing, inclusive teams.



Listen to the song we made about the role: https://suno.com/s/Sa7UY4e011wKQASM

 - Act as the trusted People partner to a function or client group’s leadership, shaping org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy for your group and owning the tradeoff calls that keep people and business priorities in balance.

 - Lead complex employee relations investigations and high-stakes performance situations end to end within your function, helping leaders navigate them with care, candor, and compliance.

 - Adapt and deliver company-wide talent management and learning and development programs, such as performance management and career progression, for your function, and measure their impact on your team, not just whether they launched.

 - Coach managers and leaders in your function through team scaling, reorgs, and performance complexity, building their capability to lead the Suno way.

 - Use workforce data, sentiment, and talent reviews in Excel and Claude to identify capability gaps and succession risk in your function, and turn insight into a recommendation leadership can act on.

 - Build trust with the managers and employees in your function through consistent, sound judgment, and mentor newer People Partners on your team as they grow into the role, strengthening the People Partner team that helps every leader at Suno build one capable of delivering on our mission of daily creative fulfillment.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED


MUST-HAVES

 - 5+ years of experience as a People Partner, with demonstrated depth partnering with leaders in a high-growth tech environment.

 - Track record leading complex employee relations investigations and high-stakes performance situations independently.

 - Sophistication in org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy.

 - Strong grounding in US employment law, including Title VII, ADA, and FMLA, plus deep experience with California employment law given Suno's presence in Los Angeles and San Francisco; comfortable operating with independence and good judgment.

 - Proven ability to translate company-wide People frameworks into a specific function's context without losing the intent behind them.

 - Experience building or significantly improving a People program, such as performance management, career progression, or compensation, with real interest in owning that kind of build as part of your remit.

 - Experience partnering with Finance on headcount budgeting and workforce modeling.

 - Hands-on with AI tools and motivated to build AI-enhanced People workflows.

 - Strong analytical fluency with People data — comfortable building and interpreting your own models (attrition forecasting, pay equity, span of control), not just reading someone else’s dashboard.

 - Track record leading complex, cross-functional programs end-to-end — multiple workstreams and competing deadlines, shipped and adopted, not just launched.

jobs.description:

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 200 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who is a true specialist in paid social performance marketing. You’ll manage our paid social campaigns end-to-end: platform partnerships, testing and measurement, driving web and app conversions at scale across markets.

This is a role for someone who has done this at real scale: you've managed paid social budgets of $30M+ annually, you understand attribution deeply, and you bring rigor, curiosity, and sharp analytical instincts to everything you touch. You should be comfortable digging into the data yourself — building your own analyses, spotting issues before anyone asks, and translating numbers into clear action. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

You're also a builder, not just an operator. When a workflow is slow or a test framework doesn't exist yet, you build it rather than waiting for someone else to. You think like a creator: better tests, sharper creative, smarter systems. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.



We made a song about the role: https://suno.com/s/owdc28Zl5z3YqWbN






WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own Paid Social channel performance globally: manage campaigns optimizing for web and app conversions, subscriptions, and growth KPIs across multiple geographies and markets. Evaluate and pilot new platforms and formats as they become relevant.

 - Drive full-funnel results: manage budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing to consistently hit CPA and ROAS targets at scale

 - Manage platform partnerships: own the relationship with paid social channel reps, including beta access, product roadmap input, billing, and spend reconciliation.

 - Own analysis and reporting: run proactive weekly performance analyses, using Excel and other tools to diagnose trends and surface opportunities. Design and run incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies) to confirm spend is driving net new users, not just capturing demand that would have converted anyway.

 - Navigate app campaign complexity: own tracking setup (Conversions API), MMP integration (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust, etc.), and mobile attribution nuance across platforms

 - Build your own tools: when something is broken or needs improvement, build the fix yourself. Write the script, build the dashboard, design the smarter test framework. You do not wait for someone else to solve it, and you use your best judgement and expertise to make sure the analysis, strategy and execution drives excellent results.

 - Partner with creative & across the business: own all creative analysis and give structured feedback on ad creative, brief new concepts, and drive iteration based on performance data. Work with lifecycle/CRM, product, data science, and finance to align on audience strategy, budget, and measurement.

 - Own budget and forecasting: manage pacing across campaigns and markets, proactively reallocating spend to what’s working

 - Communicate with clarity: translate complex campaign data into sharp insights and recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years hands-on managing conversion-optimized paid social campaigns (must have specific paid social channel experience) with multi-million annual budget responsibility across major platforms

 - Strong grasp of web conversion campaigns — pixels, events, landing page performance, and full-funnel optimization

 - Experience running global campaigns across multiple geographies and markets

 - Experience with app campaign mechanics and mobile attribution (MMPs like Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust; SKAdNetwork, postbacks, etc.)

 - Sharp analytical skills: advanced in Excel, including pivot tables, with a track record of proactively running weekly and ad hoc analyses to diagnose performance and drive decisions — not just reporting on results, but getting ahead of them

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where channels, tools, and strategy evolve constantly

 - Nice to have: experience across a broad range of paid channels beyond the major social platforms (such as, X, Snapchat, Pinterest)




ADDITIONAL NOTES

 - Must be eligible to work in the US.

 - Must be willing to work 5 days/week in-office.

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Creative Director, Marketing Campaigns to lead the conception, development, and execution of bold, culture-shaping campaigns that bring Suno’s brand to life around the world. Reporting to the Head of Brand and Creative, you’ll set the creative vision for our marketing campaigns—translating Suno’s mission of unlocking music for everyone into ideas that move audiences, define moments, and drive growth.

In this role, you’ll lead an integrated creative practice that spans brand campaigns, product launches, partnerships, content franchises, and tentpole cultural moments. You’ll shape the work end-to-end—from insight and strategy to concept, craft, and final execution—partnering with designers, writers, art directors, producers, filmmakers, marketers, and external partners to ensure every output meets the highest creative bar.

This is a role for a seasoned creative leader who thinks like a strategist, makes like a maker, and inspires like a director. You’ve built campaigns that have entered the cultural conversation, and you know how to balance ambitious storytelling with the operational rigor that high-volume marketing requires. You bring a clear point of view, an eye for craft across every medium, and the instincts to know when an idea is ready to ship—and when it needs another pass.

Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/rPLk06OyhCHNKQrr




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Set the creative vision for Suno’s marketing campaigns, developing a distinctive, ownable creative voice that scales across brand, product, partnerships, and cultural moments.

 - Lead the concepting and execution of integrated campaigns from insight to launch—owning the work across film, social, digital, OOH, experiential, partnerships, and emerging formats.

 - Partner with the Brand & Creative studio teams to evolve Suno’s brand expression, voice, and visual aesthetic, ensuring every campaign deepens equity and feels unmistakably Suno.

 - Direct and inspire a multidisciplinary team of art directors, designers, copywriters, producers, and external creative partners—building a high-trust environment where great ideas can come from anywhere.

 - Translate marketing and business objectives into creative briefs that unlock big ideas, with clear strategic intent and a sharp creative POV.

 - Pitch, sell, and shepherd ideas across the organization, presenting work persuasively to executive leadership and building cross-functional alignment around ambitious creative bets.

 - Lead production end-to-end, selecting and managing directors, photographers, animators, agencies, and production partners to deliver work at the highest level of craft.

 - Champion craft across every medium, holding a relentlessly high bar for writing, design, art direction, motion, sound, and storytelling.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Growth, Product Marketing, Social, Content, Communications, Partnerships, and Product to ensure campaigns ladder to business priorities and integrate seamlessly across channels.

 - Use cultural fluency and audience insight to identify the moments, formats, and collaborators that will make Suno’s work resonate—especially with creators, fans, and music communities.

 - Establish creative principles, processes, and rituals that protect the work, raise the bar over time, and help the creative team operate at its best.

 - Mentor and develop creative talent, growing the next generation of leaders within Suno’s creative organization.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 10+ years of experience leading creative for ambitious brands, with a portfolio of work spanning integrated campaigns, brand platforms, and culture-defining moments—ideally at a top creative agency, in-house brand, music or entertainment company, or consumer tech leader.

 - A standout body of work that demonstrates conceptual range, craft excellence, and the ability to drive cultural impact across media.

 - Proven experience as a creative leader who has built and inspired multidisciplinary teams of art directors, designers, writers, and producers.

 - Deep fluency across creative disciplines—art direction, copywriting, design, film, motion, photography, and emerging formats—with the ability to give precise, generative feedback at every stage of the work.

 - Track record of leading large-scale productions end-to-end, including selecting directors and partners, running shoots, and delivering across film, photography, social-first content, and experiential.

 - Strategic instincts: you can sit with ambiguity, identify the sharpest creative opportunity, and translate business objectives into ideas that travel.

 - Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to inspire executives, internal teams, and external collaborators around a shared creative vision.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, building trust with cross-functional partners across Growth, Product Marketing, Social, Content, Brand, Communications, and Product.

 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving, high-ambition environment, balancing long-horizon brand building with the pace and volume of an always-on marketing org.

 - A point of view on culture, music, and creative technology—you understand where audiences are headed, and you’re excited to use AI and new tools as part of the creative process.

 - A passion for music, creativity, and emerging technology; you’re energized by leading the work that defines a category-creating brand.

We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).



Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

 

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert — and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

 

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself — grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.



Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R







WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them

 - Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves

 - Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding

 - Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions

 - Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast

 - Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand

 - Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why

 - Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context

 - Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic

 - Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting

 - Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn





QUALIFICATIONS

 - You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you

 - 5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO)

 - You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them

 - You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next

 - You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar

 - You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business

 - You use AI to get more done than one person normally could

 - You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down





ADDITIONAL NOTES

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days/week at our office in NYC or LA

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and own Suno's security control framework, mapping controls to SOC 2, NIST CSF, and future frameworks, and writing control descriptions with the teams who run them.

 - Lead SOC 2 preparation end to end, from gap assessments and readiness tracking to driving remediation with control owners and working with our external auditor.

 - Automate evidence collection and control monitoring with scripts, integrations, and AI tools, deciding where human review stays in the loop.

 - Run vendor security reviews, keep our security policies current, and answer customer security questionnaires alongside Product and Legal.

 - Partner with the CISO to give leadership and the board a clear, evidence-backed view of our security posture, and lay the foundations of GRC as part of a growing Security team.

 - Help earn the trust of the partners and customers who bring Suno to more people, so creating music can be part of everyone's day.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED


MUST-HAVES

 - 7–9 years in GRC, security compliance, or IT audit.

 - Hands-on, end-to-end ownership of a security compliance program as its primary owner, ideally including taking a company through its first SOC 2.
